description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewQuick' class, which extends 'ViewDetail' and is responsible for rendering a quick view of a record in the SuiteCRM application. It sets display options, manages record validation, and outputs JSON containing the record's title, URL, and HTML content.

classes.name: ViewQuick
classes.description: A class that provides a quick view format for records within the SuiteCRM platform, rendering a JSON response with record details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewQuick object, configuring display options related to subpanels, headers, titles, footers, and JavaScript visibility.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-encoded response containing the title, URL, and HTML for the record's quick view, after performing validation and processing.
